verdict.rationale: Steel is browser infrastructure, and nothing in the evidence shows it accepting a natural-language goal and executing a task on its own. Its docs say external frameworks (OpenAI/Claude/Gemini Computer Use, Browser-Use, CrewAI, the Claude Agent SDK) run the agent loop while 'Steel handles the browser.' The Steel CLI offers explicit navigate/click/fill commands rather than goal-driven execution, so these are building blocks and third-party agent capabilities that earn no credit here.
